scenes.heading: The pipeline

steps.label: Timing
steps.detail: real audio length sets each cue

scenes.narration: Here's the pipeline. [[next]] Claude writes the script as JSON. [[next]] Kokoro, a local neural voice, reads each line, and Whisper listens back for mistakes. [[next]] Real audio lengths set the timing. [[next]] And Remotion renders the MP4.

scenes.heading: A scene is just data
scenes.narration: Each scene is a small block like this. The type picks a layout, and next markers tell each visual exactly when to appear, in sync with the voice.

scenes.heading: Look, then render
scenes.narration: [[next]] First, Claude renders a still of every scene and checks the layout. [[next]] Then one command renders the video, with subtitles.
